headline: Pierrakakis: The opposition wants a 13th pension and salary and the abolition of excise duty and VAT - It is not a wish list
summary: Finance Minister Kyriakos Pierrakakis responded to opposition demands for a 13th pension, a 13th salary and abolition of fuel excise duty and VAT. He said the demands are not a wish list.
why: Greek fiscal policy, including tax and pension spending, determines the government's budget room and debt sustainability, which matter to Greek government bond investors.
